gui.workbay.bay.empty.tip: Hold a machine and click here to rack it.
gui.workbay.bay.inert: Nothing can reach this machine on any face. It keeps running; no link can use it.
gui.workbay.bay.locked.tip: Install an Expansion Plate to open this bay.
gui.workbay.bay.rack.hint: Hold a machine and click the slot.
gui.workbay.bay.rack.tip: Hold a machine and click to rack it in this bay.
gui.workbay.button.eject.tip: Take this machine out of its bay, with everything inside it.
gui.workbay.button.enter.tip: Puts you next to it and opens its own screen. Close that to come back.
gui.workbay.button.flow.tip: See what every link moves, and which flows never leave this block.
gui.workbay.button.lock.tip: A locked Workbay only lets its owner rack, eject or change anything.
gui.workbay.button.networks.tip: Which network this Workbay is, and every other one you own. Move one here, or rename it.
gui.workbay.button.open.tip: Opens the machine's own screen without leaving where you stand.
gui.workbay.button.paste.tip: Replaces this bay's face settings with the copied ones.
gui.workbay.button.rename.tip: Name this bay. Return commits, Escape cancels, empty goes back to the machine's.
gui.workbay.button.rooms.tip: Somewhere to build, out the back. A Connector works in a room, so one can be a stage in a chain rather than only a place to stand.
gui.workbay.button.upgrades.tip: Install Expansion Plates, a Resonator or an Impeller.

gui.workbay.connector.unused: No channels yet · open a bay, press Add and pick this
gui.workbay.door.go.tip: Straight into that room. You still come out where you first came in.
gui.workbay.door.leave.tip: Back to exactly where you were standing when you came in.
gui.workbay.door.title: Way out
gui.workbay.faces.empty: Rack a machine to set its faces.

gui.workbay.faces.role.none: Unset. With no face set, links use whichever face answers.
gui.workbay.faces.role.output: Output. Links may pull out of this face.

gui.workbay.filter.carrying: Click a slot to list it, anywhere else to drop it.
gui.workbay.filter.chemical: List what is in the tank
gui.workbay.filter.chemical.none: Carrying every chemical this tank offers.
gui.workbay.filter.chemical.tip: A chemical has no item to drag in, so a chemical filter is named from the tank it is already in. Click again to carry everything.
gui.workbay.filter.empty: Nothing listed. This link carries everything.
gui.workbay.filter.energy.tip: Energy is a number, so there is nothing here to name.
gui.workbay.filter.entry.tag.tip: Everything in this tag, not just this one thing. Shift-click for the next tag, or round to the item itself.
gui.workbay.filter.entry.tip: Click to lift it off. Right-click to drop it.
gui.workbay.filter.inventory.putback.tip: Click to put down what is on the cursor.
gui.workbay.filter.inventory.tip: Click to put a copy on the cursor, then click a filter slot to list it. Nothing leaves your inventory - a filter names an item, it does not hold one.
gui.workbay.filter.listed.allow: Only what is listed goes through.
gui.workbay.filter.listed.deny: Everything except what is listed goes through.
gui.workbay.filter.mode.tip: Whitelist carries only what is listed; blacklist carries the rest.
gui.workbay.filter.slot.tip.fluid: Click to drop what you are carrying here. A bucket or tank lists the fluid inside it; a recipe-list drag works too.
gui.workbay.filter.slot.tip.item: Click to drop what you are carrying here. With empty hands it lists what you are holding, and a recipe-list drag works too.
gui.workbay.filter.tip: What this link may carry. Empty carries everything.
gui.workbay.flow.canvas.tip: Every link this Workbay has, as the graph it makes. Drag to move the view, scroll to zoom. Hover a box for what it is.

gui.workbay.links.add.apply.tip: Adds everything ticked on both tabs in one go, then closes the picker.
gui.workbay.links.add.bay.tip: Makes a link straight to that bay. No Connector, no block in the world.
gui.workbay.links.add.connector.back.tip: A channel through this Connector is waiting off its bay. This puts it on bay %s with its resource, filter and rate kept, instead of adding a blank one beside it.
gui.workbay.links.add.connector.tip: Gives bay %s its own channel through this Connector — its own resource, direction, filter and rate. Every other bay keeps what it has; one Connector can serve all of them at once.
gui.workbay.links.add.none.bays: No other bays. Rack a second one first.

gui.workbay.links.add.tab.tip: Every Connector this network owns, or the bays in this rack.
gui.workbay.links.add.tip: Everything this bay can talk through: a Connector standing in the world, or another bay.
gui.workbay.links.bay.tip: Which bay this link belongs to.
gui.workbay.links.disable.tip: Click to stop this link without deleting it.
gui.workbay.links.enable.tip: A new link starts off. Click to turn it on.
gui.workbay.links.end.emptybay: This bay has nothing racked in it, so this end of the link reaches nothing.
gui.workbay.links.end.unknown: Nothing is remembered about the block at this end yet.
gui.workbay.links.face.tip: Which side of the target to reach into. Pin one when in and out are on different faces; right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.links.filter.tip: Click to change which links this list shows. Right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.links.internal.retarget.tip: Click to point this link at the next bay instead. Right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.links.internal.tip: A link straight to another bay, with no Connector to place.
gui.workbay.links.mode.tip: Click to turn this link around.
gui.workbay.links.none: No channels on this bay yet. Press Add and pick a Connector.
gui.workbay.links.none.here: No links on this bay. %s on other bays — press Add to move one here.
gui.workbay.links.pair.tip: Pairs the held Connector to this Workbay. Place it on the block you want to reach, then add it to whichever bays should talk through it.
gui.workbay.links.problems.tip: Show only the links in trouble.
gui.workbay.links.rate.tip: How much this link moves in one step. Hold shift for ten at a time, ctrl for a hundred.
gui.workbay.links.remove.tip: The link keeps its filter, rate and name and waits under Add. Breaking the Connector is what deletes one.
gui.workbay.links.rename.tip: Right-click to name this Connector. The name is the block's, so every channel through it reads the same. Empty goes back to the derived name.
gui.workbay.links.sort.added: In the order they were made

gui.workbay.links.target.tip: What this link is pointed at.
gui.workbay.links.type.tip: Click to change what this link carries. Right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.networks.empty.tip: Start one here, or move one of yours in.
gui.workbay.networks.footer.tip: One Workbay block is one network, and this server lets you own this many. Placing more Workbays is never refused: one placed with no network left to take stands there empty until you move a network into it. A network with no block sleeps and keeps everything - bays, machines, Connectors and channels - until a block is pointed at it again.
gui.workbay.networks.new.tip: Makes a fresh network in this Workbay: two empty bays, no Connectors, nothing racked. It counts against the number of networks you may own.
gui.workbay.networks.none: You do not own a network yet.
gui.workbay.networks.quota.tip: Every network you own already has a block. Pick one and press Transfer to move it here.
gui.workbay.networks.rename.tip: One network, one name — it changes everywhere this network is named at once.
gui.workbay.networks.transfer.asleep.tip: Moves %s into this Workbay whole: its bays, the machines in them, its Connectors, its channels and its upgrades.
gui.workbay.networks.transfer.here.tip: This Workbay is already this network.
gui.workbay.networks.transfer.live.tip: Moves %s into this Workbay whole. The block it is in now is left standing and empty; nothing in the network is lost.
gui.workbay.power.tip: Energy stored in the Workbay itself. Hosted machines keep their own.
gui.workbay.redstone.always.tip: These links run whatever the redstone is doing. Right-click steps back.
gui.workbay.redstone.pulse.tip: One operation each time the signal turns on.
gui.workbay.redstone.with_signal.tip: This bay's links run only while the Workbay has a redstone signal.
gui.workbay.redstone.without_signal.tip: This bay's links run only while the Workbay has no redstone signal.
gui.workbay.rooms.anchored.tip: Keeps what is inside this room running with nobody in it, holding %s chunks loaded. Click to switch off.
gui.workbay.rooms.biome.label: Behaves like
gui.workbay.rooms.biome.none: This pack lists no room biomes
gui.workbay.rooms.biome.tip: What a machine in here reads for temperature and rainfall. Nothing falls from the sky: a cold room is cold, it does not snow.
gui.workbay.rooms.colour.label: Walls
gui.workbay.rooms.colour.tip: What this room's shell is painted.
gui.workbay.rooms.enter.tip: Go and stand in it. A door in the middle of each wall brings you back — and a Connector works in here, so a barrel in a room is a stage in a chain.
gui.workbay.rooms.guest.build.tip: May do anything in this room that you can. Click to drop back to Look only.
gui.workbay.rooms.guest.look.tip: May stand here. No blocks broken or placed, and no containers opened. Click to raise to May work.
gui.workbay.rooms.guest.use.tip: May open what is here and take from it, and may break or place nothing. Click to raise to May build.
gui.workbay.rooms.guests.invite.tip: Invites them to look. Raise to May work if they are here to run the place, or to May build if they are here to change it.
gui.workbay.rooms.guests.label: Guests
gui.workbay.rooms.guests.name: player name
gui.workbay.rooms.guests.remove.tip: They are put out of the room at once, even if they are standing in it.
gui.workbay.rooms.guests.tip: To this room only — never to your others, and never to the dimension.
gui.workbay.rooms.name: Room %s
gui.workbay.rooms.none: Install a Room Frame above for your first room.
gui.workbay.rooms.remove.sure.tip: Click again to take the room down. Anything else on this screen calls it off.
gui.workbay.rooms.remove.tip: Takes the shell down and frees the slot. Only an empty room, and it asks again before it does it.
gui.workbay.rooms.rename.tip: Right-click to name this room. Empty goes back to Room 1, Room 2.
gui.workbay.rooms.tab.guests.tip: Who else may be in this room.
gui.workbay.rooms.tab.room.tip: What this room looks like: its colour and its biome.
gui.workbay.rooms.unanchored.tip: What is inside runs only while somebody is in here. Anchoring holds %s chunks loaded.
gui.workbay.status.connector_gone.tip: Its Connector was broken. The row clears itself shortly.
gui.workbay.status.detached.tip: Taken off its bay and kept. Put it on one with Add.
gui.workbay.status.disabled.tip: Turned off in this link's settings.
gui.workbay.status.held_by_redstone.tip: Waiting on this bay's redstone mode. Nothing is wrong.
gui.workbay.status.idle.tip: Nothing to move. This is the normal resting state.
gui.workbay.status.machine_no_face.tip: This bay has faces set, but none for this link's direction. Mark one in to pull, out to send.
gui.workbay.status.machine_no_port.tip: The machine answers on none of the faces this link may use. Most open a face only once you set it in their own side config.
gui.workbay.status.needs_resonator.tip: This link crosses into another dimension. Install a Resonator to let it.
gui.workbay.status.no_power.tip: The Workbay's buffer is empty. Running links costs power; feed the block and they start again where they left off.
gui.workbay.status.running.tip: This link moved something on its last turn.
gui.workbay.status.target_missing.tip: The dimension this link points into is gone.
gui.workbay.status.target_no_port.tip: The target is there but has nothing this link can connect to on any face.
gui.workbay.status.target_not_loaded.tip: The target's chunk is unloaded. It resumes on its own.
gui.workbay.title: Workbay
gui.workbay.upgrade.anchor.long: Keeps the Backshop running with nobody there. It holds this Workbay's own chunk and its bay column, which is what lets its links keep moving goods after you log out, and it lets a room be switched on below to hold its own chunks too.
gui.workbay.upgrade.annex_plate.long: One more room, at whatever size your Room Frame sets. It does not change the size of the rooms you have.
gui.workbay.upgrade.expansion_plate.long: One more bay on this rack. A machine lives in a bay, so this is how many machines one Workbay can hold at once.
gui.workbay.upgrade.impeller.long: Every link on this Workbay moves twice as much per step and waits half as long between steps. Two of them stack.
gui.workbay.upgrade.resonator.long: Lets a link's two ends stand in different dimensions. Without one, a Connector in the Nether cannot be reached from an overworld Workbay -- the Backshop itself always can.
gui.workbay.upgrade.room_frame.long: Buys your first room, and sets the size of every room this network owns. Installing a bigger Frame later grows the room you already have where it stands: nothing is moved and nothing inside it is lost.
gui.workbay.upgrade.vast_room_frame.long: Grows every room this network owns to 46 blocks across, in place. What is built inside stays exactly where it is; the walls move outwards around it.
gui.workbay.upgrade.wide_room_frame.long: Grows every room this network owns to 30 blocks across, in place. What is built inside stays exactly where it is; the walls move outwards around it.
gui.workbay.upgrades.maxed: You have as many of these as a Workbay takes.
info.workbay.anchor.1: Keeps the Backshop running with nobody standing at the Workbay, so a chain of machines out the back carries on while you are away doing something else. Switch it on per room, on the Rooms tab.
info.workbay.anchor.2: It holds nothing while its owner is offline. Log out and the chunks are let go; log back in and they are taken again, with the chain carrying on from where it stopped. Nothing is lost in the gap, because nothing this mod moves is ever in transit between two ticks.
info.workbay.annex_plate.1: One more room, consumed on install. It needs a Room Frame first — with no rooms to add to it would install and do nothing, so it refuses instead.
info.workbay.connector.1: One end of a link, as a block you can point at. Right-click a Workbay with it to pair the two; its tooltip then names the network. Place it against a chest, tank or machine and the network can reach that block. It carries nothing yet — open a bay, press Add, and pick it. Break it and every channel through it is gone.
info.workbay.connector.2: It reaches all six faces of the block it is stuck to, so which side you put it on does not matter — and one Connector serves every bay at once. Add it on the bay holding your power cube for energy, and again on the bay holding your generator for items: two channels, one plate, each with its own resource, direction, filter and rate. Its name is the block's, so renaming it anywhere renames it everywhere.
info.workbay.connector.3: A link out of the dimension its Workbay stands in needs a Resonator. Anything inside that dimension, and anything in the Backshop, does not.
info.workbay.expansion_plate.1: One more bay, consumed on install. Each one One more bay, up to the eight the rack holds.
info.workbay.housing.1: An intermediate. The shell every craftable in this mod is built on.
info.workbay.impeller.1: Doubles what every link moves in a step and halves the wait between steps — both, on every link this network has. Two may be fitted. Throughput is the one thing a fresh Workbay is deliberately short of.
info.workbay.resonator.1: Lets this network's links reach into other dimensions. Without one, a Connector in the Nether pointing at a Workbay in the Overworld sits still, and its row says so.
info.workbay.room_frame.1: A room: a private, sealed cube out the back of the Backshop that you walk into and build in. Consumed on install.
info.workbay.room_frame.2: The Frame you install sets the size of every room you own — 14 blocks on a side, 30 for a Wide Frame, 46 for a Vast one. A larger Frame expands the room you already have rather than giving you a second; the Annex Plate is what gives you a second.
info.workbay.room_frame.3: Pick a room's biome and its colour on the Rooms tab, and invite other players in there while you are at it. The four doors in the walls are the way out, and they cannot be broken.
info.workbay.shopsteel.1: An intermediate. Smelted, and used in almost everything this mod makes.
info.workbay.workbay.1: A Workbay hosts other mods' machines inside a private dimension and reaches them wirelessly. A racked machine runs exactly as it did on your floor — it is out of sight, not out of the world. It does not save TPS. What it saves is the floor space, and the cables.
info.workbay.workbay.2: The first three things to do:
info.workbay.workbay.3: 1. Place it and right-click it. The column down the left is your bays; a fresh Workbay has two, and the rest are bought later. Hold a machine and click the large slot beside the name to rack it.
info.workbay.workbay.4: 2. Right-click the Workbay with a Connector to pair the two, then place that Connector against any chest, tank or machine in the world. Placing it is what makes the link, and the link appears as a row on this screen.
info.workbay.workbay.5: 3. Set that row's direction and what it carries. Insert pushes into the block the Connector is stuck to; Extract pulls out of it. The Workbay glows while goods are moving and goes amber when a link needs you.
info.workbay.workbay.6: Everything past that is an upgrade you craft and fit on the Upgrades tab — more bays, faster links, and rooms out the back. Each one is consumed when it goes in, and there is no taking it out again.
message.workbay.anchor_capped: This network may anchor %s room(s) at a time. Switch another one off first.
message.workbay.annex_needs_frame: An Annex Plate adds a room to a network that already has one. Install a Room Frame first.
message.workbay.bay_load_timeout: The bay did not reach your client in time. Try again.
message.workbay.bay_no_screen: %s has no screen of its own.
message.workbay.break_warning: Breaking this Workbay leaves its bays behind. The machines keep running — place any fresh Workbay to get back in.
message.workbay.connector_linked: Connector set on %s, for %s. Add it on a bay to give that bay a channel.
message.workbay.connector_no_workbay: The Workbay this Connector is paired to isn't loaded. Go back to it and place this again.
message.workbay.connector_paired: Connector paired to %s. Place it, then add it to a bay.
message.workbay.connector_unpaired: This Connector isn't paired yet. Right-click a Workbay with it first.
message.workbay.filter_no_chemical: There is no chemical in that tank to name. Fill it first, then list what is in it.
message.workbay.guest_is_owner: That is you. The room is already yours.
message.workbay.guest_unknown: This server has never seen a player called %s. They have to have logged in once before they can be invited.
message.workbay.internal_link_needs_seco: This Workbay only has one bay. Install an Expansion Plate before linking bay to bay.
message.workbay.network_cap_reached: You already own the maximum of %s Workbay network(s). Break one before starting another.
message.workbay.network_created: %s created. Everything in it is yours; break the block and it sleeps here until you put one back.
message.workbay.network_quota: This Workbay holds no network yet — every one you own already has a block. Open it to move one here.
message.workbay.network_reused: Workbay reconnected — same bays, same links, same upgrades as before.
message.workbay.network_transferred: %s moved here. The block it came from is standing empty.
message.workbay.pair_needs_connector: Hold a Connector — main hand or off hand — to pair one to this bay.
message.workbay.reject.bay_occupied: This bay already has something standing in it. Pick an empty bay, or eject what is there first.
message.workbay.reject.empty_hand: Hold the machine you want to rack, then click the bay.
message.workbay.reject.kinetic: %s runs on rotational force. A bay can't turn a shaft.
message.workbay.reject.multiblock: %s is part of a multiblock. A bay holds one block; build it in a room instead.
message.workbay.reject.needs_neighbours: %s works by connecting to the blocks around it. A bay has no neighbours to connect to.
message.workbay.reject.no_bay: Every bay is full. Install an Expansion Plate for another.
message.workbay.reject.no_machine: %s has nothing running inside it. A bay can only hold a block with a block entity.
message.workbay.reject.no_ports: %s has no item, fluid or energy ports. A bus would have nothing to connect to.
message.workbay.reject.not_a_block: %s isn't a block. A bay holds machines.
message.workbay.reject.op_only_data: %s carries settings only an operator may place. Racking it would rack an empty one, so it is refused instead.
message.workbay.reject.pack_denied: This pack doesn't allow %s to be hosted.
message.workbay.reject.rack_failed: %s wouldn't stand up in a bay, so nothing was placed. You still have it.
message.workbay.reject.recursion: A Workbay can't go inside a Workbay.
message.workbay.reject.world_interacting: %s works on the world around it. A bay is empty, so it would have nothing to do.
message.workbay.room_created: Workbay network created and bound to your account. Lose the block and a fresh, uncrafted Workbay picks it straight back up.
message.workbay.room_look_only: You were invited to look at this room, not to change it. Its owner can raise that to Build.
message.workbay.room_not_empty: There is a %s in that room. A room is only given back once it is empty - nothing you built is thrown away here.
message.workbay.room_not_yours: That room isn't yours. Ask its owner to invite you from the room's own settings.
message.workbay.room_use_only: You were invited to work this room, not to change it. Open what is here as you like; its owner can raise that to May build.
message.workbay.upgrade_maxed: This Workbay already has as many of those as it takes.
message.workbay.upgrade_missing: You don't have one of those to install.
tooltip.workbay.connector_unpaired: Not paired. Right-click a Workbay with this to pair it.
